BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ferry district authority; and amending RCW 36.54.120.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 36.54.120 and 2003 c 83 s 302 are each amended to read as follows:County ferry districts—District may construct, purchase, operate, and maintain passenger-only ferries and wharves.
BillSection.P: A ferry district may construct, purchase, operate, and maintain passenger-only ferries or wharves at any unfordable stream, lake, estuary, or bay within or bordering the ferry district, or between portions of the ferry district, or between the ferry district and other ferry districts, together with all the necessary boats, grounds, roads, approaches, and landings appertaining thereto under the direction and control of the governing body of the ferry district, free or for toll as the governing body determines by resolution.
